title: Eat Absolutely Everything
description: Take a bite of absolutely everything, and experience its taste!
body:
# Eat Absolutely Everything > **Why should the food tab have all the fun?** > > Dirt? Delicious. Obsidian? Crunchy. Your friend's Diamond Block? ...probably worth a taste. **Eat Absolutely Everything** is a Fabric mod that puts your diet in your hands, by letting you consume literally any item or block in Minecraft (including from other mods!).
Update Roadmap - Hiding item effects until they have been eaten for the first time. - Adding a detailed Advancement tree, with multiple pathways. - Minimal balancing (I don't care about balancing) - Over 25 new unique effects! - [Adding new suggested effects!](https://github.com/CheesierPasta/eat-absolutely-everything-issues)
--- ## Every Item Unlocks a Different Taste This isn't just a joke mod that turns everything into food. Every edible item has a unique effect determined by an _intelligent_ priority system, making experimentation both rewarding and chaotic. Meaning a **Diamond Block**, a **Command Block**, and a **Poppy** won't all taste the same... ...and your Minecraft-y taste buds won't feel the same too. --- ## Hundreds of Possibilities Eating something can grant: - ❤️ Instant Health - 💔 Instant Damage - 🍗 Saturation - 💖 Extra Hearts - 🧪 Potion Effects - 👾 Summon Entities - 🎁 Give Items ...and much more! Multiple effects can even be combined on a single item, leading to some truly ridiculous outcomes. --- ## Works With Other Mods _One of the best parts?_ **Eat Absolutely Everything** doesn't stop at vanilla. Because effects are determined using item data, items and blocks from other mods are automatically edible too. > **If you can hold it...** > > **...you can eat it.** --- ## "But... Why?" Because Minecraft has spent years telling you what you can't eat. **This mod respectfully disagrees.** --- ![The keybind control panel, showing the default keybind for the "Alternate Eat"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4264a6b5a6ea4535e4782c03a8e2bc26ac26aae_0.webp) ## How To Eat 1. Hold any item. 2. Hold `Alt` 3. Hold `Right Click` 4. Question your life choices. --- ## Warning Side effects of using **Eat Absolutely Everything** may include: - Consuming valuable resources. - Unexpected explosions. - Questionable dietary decisions. - Accidentally eating your base. **You have been warned.** --- ### Fake Legal Disclaimer By downloading, installing, or interacting with **Eat Absolutely Everything**, you acknowledge that: - You waive absolutely all rights, claims, complaints, grievances, emotional damages, physical damages, existential damages, and any remaining sanity arising from or relating to: - Eating literally anything in-game - Unexpected consequences of eating literally anything in-game - Thinking “this seemed like a good idea at the time” - The developer is not responsible for: - Lost items, destroyed bases, broken saves, broken friendships, or broken reality - Any philosophical crises triggered by consuming a beacon - You agree that: - Obsidian is, in fact, edible - You chose this path willingly - I warned you. _This disclaimer has no legal value whatsoever, but it feels official, which is what really matters._
